title: Reduce presubmit setup latency by adding mutable workspace cache and staged toolchain bootstrap
author: Clara Nguyen
description:
Motivation: Our presubmit latency analysis showed a 30-45% setup time dominated by toolchain boot and repeated dependency installs across CI jobs. This PR introduces a mutable workspace cache that persists compact toolchain artifacts between presubmit runs and a staged toolchain bootstrap that installs minimal tooling first (fast path) and completes the full bootstrap lazily on longer-running lanes. The goal is to reduce developer feedback time without changing test semantics.

Summary of changes: - Add a new cache driver 'mutable-workspace' implemented as an opt-in action that keeps a curated set of toolchain artifacts (small binaries, pip wheels, yarn cache shards, docker builder layers) keyed by repo+major-toolchain-hash. - Introduce 'staged_bootstrap.sh' and a lightweight Go wrapper to orchestrate fast/complete bootstraps based on job annotations. - Update composite CI templates to call the mutable cache restore step early and to annotate lanes that may run the full bootstrap asynchronously. - Add metrics and traces for presubmit cold-start and cache hit/miss rates, exposed via existing CI telemetry. - Add migration docs and devcontainer snippets to keep local dev experience aligned.

Commits (high level): - 4b92a7b: introduce mutable-workspace cache action and docs - 9c3e02f: staged toolchain bootstrap script + go wrapper - a7fdd2c: integrate cache into presubmit templates and annotate lanes - d558b31: test harness & CI telemetry (counters/tags) - ee12c9a: docs, migration notes, and unit tests for cache driver

Files changed (high level): - .github/actions/mutable-workspace/action.yml (new) - .github/actions/mutable-workspace/entrypoint.sh (new) - infra/ci/templates/presubmit-composite.yml (modified) - infra/ci/staged_bootstrap/staged_bootstrap.sh (new) - infra/ci/staged_bootstrap/boot_wrap.go (new) - internal/ci/telemetry/metrics.go (modified) - docs/ci/cache-migration.md (new) - devcontainer/README.md (modified) - scripts/dev/local-bootstrap.sh (modified)

Testing / CI: All matrix lanes were executed in the pre-merge run: lint, unit, integration-smoke. Cache hit simulation tests were added to the CI-shared test harness to assert correct restore/save semantics. Observed improvements: average presubmit workspace setup reduced from ~110s to ~45s on hot-cache lanes; cold-cache full bootstrap (first run) unchanged but subsequent runs benefit. CI results summary: lint: pass, unit: pass, integration-smoke: pass, e2e-nightly: skipped (not part of presubmit).

Review conversation (selected): - Arjun Patel (reviewer): "This looks promising; can we be sure the mutable cache cannot leak sensitive credentials between runs?" - Clara (author): "Cache keys include repo slug and toolchain-major-hash; action clears any env-sensitive files and we added an allowlist for items persisted. See infra/ci/templates/presubmit-composite.yml for explicit cleanup steps." - Maya Singh (reviewer): "I want to see that flaky tests aren't being masked by the cache — please add a CI guard to force clean bootstrap on flakes" - Clara: "Added a 'force_clean_bootstrap' annotation that test runners can toggle; also added a weekly clean-run job to verify full bootstrap fidelity." - Liam O'Connor (approver): "LGTM after minor telemetry naming nit; thanks for the migration doc."

Design notes and risk mitigation: - Opt-in by default: new repos must flip the presubmit template flag to opt into mutable caching. We did not flip existing heavy repos in this PR to reduce blast radius. - Integrity: cache validation checksum for persisted artifacts and a background janitor job that prunes stale entries older than 30 days. - Security: persisted items are restricted to non-secret artifacts; we added scanning to CI to fail if a secret-like file is accidentally persisted. - Observability: expose 'ci.presubmit.cache.hit' and 'ci.presubmit.bootstrap.phase.duration' metrics.

Migration and rollout plan: - Stage 1 (this PR): introduce action and template changes behind flag, docs and examples. - Stage 2: opt-in for small/fast repos for 2 weeks, monitor cache hit/miss and dev feedback. - Stage 3: roll out to mid-size repos with an escalation path. - Rollback: remove opt-in flag or set 'force_clean_bootstrap' for specific repo lanes.

Checklist: - [x] small, well-scoped action with unit tests - [x] CI matrix green - [x] docs & migration notes - [x] telemetry instrumentation - [x] reviewers approved - [x] rollout plan documented

Release notes: Implement presubmit mutable workspace cache and staged toolchain bootstrap to reduce presubmit setup latency; opt-in via presubmit template flag; telemetry added.

Related: ENG-4201 (presubmit perf initiative), SUP-3412 (support ticket referencing slow presubmits).

Merge outcome: Squash-merged to main after approvals. Post-merge actions include scheduling the janitor job and adding a lightweight demo to templates repo.

Notes for maintainers: If you see spurious cache misses in the wild, check CI agent platform variations and toolchain-major-hash mismatches; debugging steps are in docs/ci/cache-migration.md.
